413:t_3:123.en:
$$レド$$
「I want to know more... about women... about $$エイミー$$.」

413:t_3:125.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm counting on you from now on, too.」

413:t_3:126.en:
$$エイミー$$
「And I'm counting on you, $$レド$$!」

413:t_10:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Oh, it's you, $$ＡＧ$$... It seems I worried you, too.」

413:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You seem to have returned a little bigger than before.」

413:t_10:6.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't think a body can grow in just a week or so...」

413:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That isn't what I meant. A certain publisher's books say people can appear gigantic through the intimidating force of their fighting aura.」

413:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The intensity you showed when you defeated that fake Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ alone was enough to do that.」

413:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It produced 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s... I'll add them to the team's stock.」

413:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... My apologies. Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ is a sensitive subject.」

413:t_10:12.en:
$$レド$$
「...Now we'll never know what he was thinking, or how he arrived at those ideas...」

413:t_10:13.en:
$$レド$$
「But I rejected them, so I could live as a human being.」

413:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is admirable. I look forward to seeing you grow from here on.」

413:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a human, please feel joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure, and produce plenty of $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

413:t_10:22.en:
$$宗介$$
「Stay away from the Captain, pirate!」

413:t_10:23.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Oh? I only came to see the face of the heroine who stole my title. Isn't that a fine greeting?」

413:t_10:24.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Hehe... With that sweet face that looks like it couldn't hurt a fish, you've certainly outdone yourself.」

413:t_10:26.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Don't be so frightened. I... don't dislike cute girls, either.」

413:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But doesn't it feel nice? You've finally come home, after all.」

413:t_10:33.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am a Pilot Support and Enlightenment Interface. I possess no function called feelings.」

413:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$レド$$ has changed from a soldier into a human, so you will need to change as well.」

413:t_10:35.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I approve of that suggestion. I am also already aware of how to demonstrate my transformation.」

413:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then here we go! Let's eagerly get down to...」

413:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That was splendid! You're growing, too, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

413:t_10:39.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I raise a skeptical question. What purpose does making every member of $c say those words serve?」

414:t_000:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$... How is the equipment $$ピニオン$$ prepared for us?」

414:t_000:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「It is usable without issue. I expect a 20% increase in my combat capability.」

414:t_000:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー#robot$$ is approaching.」

414:t_001:0.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「$$レド$$... Our mission is to bring a new order to this planet.」

414:t_001:2.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「You have no intention of returning to my command... Then...」

414:t_002:0.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I've mobilized part of my fleet's forces. I'll shoot you down with them.」

414:t_002:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Even this isn't their full strength...!」

414:t_002:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. I have confirmed an approaching energy mass.」

414:t_002:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I detect no need to do so.」

414:t_003:1.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Serves you right, bastard! Don't think everything will go your way!」

414:t_003:3.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Yeah, $$レド$$! This is the treasure's beam cannon I fixed up!」

414:t_003:4.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Leave this to me and $$フランジ$$! Thanks to you drawing that precious idol away, we should be able to handle things!」

414:t_003:6.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Help will reach you soon, too! I'm counting on you to deal with the idol, $$レド$$!」

414:t_005:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Oh my, do forgive my unseemly behavior!」

414:t_005:1.en:
$$レド$$
「It's the woman pirate from before...!」

414:t_005:2.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「You can leave this to me. Would you be a dear and deal with the idol, young man?」

414:t_005:5.en:
$$レド$$
「This planet belongs to its people! You're the fool for failing to understand that!」

414:t_005:6.en:
$$レド$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$! I'll stop you!」

414:t_006:0.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「...Listen, $$レド$$... Won't you help me change this planet...?」

414:t_007:0.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll stake it all on this! We'll grapple with him, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

414:t_008:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$! Send the emergency release signal! Force $$ストライカー#robot$$'s hatch open!」

414:t_009:0.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「...Having you here would help...」

414:t_009:2.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「What do you say... Will you... serve under me... a...gain.........?」

414:t_009:4.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I am rebooting the attitude control system.」

414:t_010:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ was already dead... Then... that $$ストライカー#pilot$$ is...」

414:t_010:1.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, your resistance is meaningless.」

414:t_010:2.en:
$$レド$$
「It can't be...! Then the one I've been talking to all this time was...!」

414:t_010:3.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I will eliminate you.」
